notes: Posted 30 June 2001, before Coruscant (the post calls itself post-Tatooine); the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'starting (8)' (nine cards are listed): WYS, Boonta Eve Podrace, Podrace Prep, Podrace Arena, Tatooine Docking Bay 94, Cantina, Tatooine, Squadron Assignments and Anakin's Podracer; these count toward the 60. Squadron Assignments is shown as the starting effect.
The section headed 'extra locations (2)' names only one card (Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm). The list adds up to 59 as published; kept as posted.
'purple (1)' is the Epic Event section heading (I Did It!), not a card.
Posted 'grabber' is unnamed and kept as written; 'triple card' names no card and is kept as written.

Posted 'WYS' dested Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough; 'tatooine' the Light Premiere system Tatooine; 'cantina' Tatooine: Cantina (Light); 'tatooine lars moisture farm' the Light Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm; 'squadron assignement' Squadron Assignments; 'control / tunnel vison' Control & Tunnel Vision; 'narshada wind chimes / out of somewhere' Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes & Out Of Somewhere; 'red squadron1' Red Squadron 1; 'artoo and threepio' Artoo & Threepio; 'owen and beru lars' Owen Lars & Beru Lars.
Ounee Ta is the 2001 Effect, not the Reflections III Defensive Shield.
